description: This false-colour satellite image depicts a landscape mosaic consisting of agricultural fields and forest areas. Dense forest, characteristic of "Mixed forest" as defined in the surrounding context, is shown in dark red and burgundy hues, prominent in the upper right and along a diagonal strip in the central-left portion of the image. Agricultural fields appear as large, distinct rectangular parcels, with varying colours: some are dark green, indicating active vegetation, while others display shades of pink and lighter red, suggesting different crop types or phenological stages in a false-colour infrared representation. A yellow arrow highlights a linear feature that marks a clear boundary between a large dark green agricultural area and a darker, reddish-brown vegetated strip, potentially a mixed forest edge or a "Transitional woodland and scrub" zone. The image illustrates distinct land cover transitions in a managed environment.
